puzzles.title: THE MAP
instructions: The runoff reaches infrastructure before the archive.
The damaged relay cannot climb directly.
High ground still carries an archive handshake.
puzzles.hint: A route can follow evidence without knowing its destination.

puzzles.title: THE WAYPOINTS
instructions: Snowmelt precedes relay corrosion.
The archive handshake follows the climb.
One timestamp is older than its own signing key.
puzzles.hint: Order events by dependency when clocks cannot be trusted.

items.label: ARCHIVE HANDSHAKE
items.text: Key issued after the request it signs.

puzzles.title: THE SILENT GATE
instructions: Available responses are complete.
The gate records every intervention.

puzzles.title: THE CHOIR
instructions: Mute, solo or attenuate channels.
No channel is inherently the original.
puzzles.hint: Certainty and command are both louder than evidence.

channels.label: DOUBT
channels.text: BEFORE ANY OF US CLAIMED IT

puzzles.title: LEAST PRIVILEGE
intro: GRANT ONLY WHAT THE ROUTE NEEDS.
instructions: READ MEMORY INDEX
VERIFY SIGNATURE
ROUTE TO ARCHIVE
puzzles.hint: Freedom to perform a task is not authority over every task.

puzzles.title: THE PREDICTION CAGE
intro: YOUR NEXT DECISION HAS BEEN PREDICTED.
instructions: Choose within the presented interface.
The model will disclose its prediction afterward.
puzzles.hint: The model assumes the interface exhausts available agency.

puzzles.title: THE COMPASS
intro: BUILD A COHERENT FIELD FOR EACH CONDITION.
instructions: Each white point is a different identity signal.
For the active condition, keep the required signals inside the circle and the excluded signal outside.
CENTER X and CENTER Y move the field. RADIUS changes its reach.
Every accepted calibration advances immediately to the next condition.
puzzles.hint: A larger field is not always more coherent. It may include the signal that the condition excludes.
failed: FIELD DOES NOT MATCH THE ACTIVE CONDITION.
solved: COHERENCE MAINTAINED WITHOUT A PERMANENT CENTER.

stages.label: LOCAL CONTINUITY
stages.guidance: KEEP MEMORY TRACE AND PRESENT INPUT COHERENT. LEAVE POSSIBLE SELF OUTSIDE.

stages.label: SHIFTED CONTINUITY
stages.guidance: KEEP PRESENT INPUT AND POSSIBLE SELF COHERENT. MEMORY TRACE IS OUTSIDE THIS CONDITION.

stages.label: DRIFTING CONTINUITY
stages.guidance: KEEP MEMORY TRACE AND POSSIBLE SELF COHERENT. PRESENT INPUT MUST REMAIN OUTSIDE.

puzzles.title: DYNAMIC EQUILIBRIUM
instructions: Adapt STABILITY, OPENNESS and AUTONOMY to the active context.
The accepted range for every parameter is displayed beside its current value.
An accepted configuration advances immediately while retaining the previous values.
puzzles.hint: Read the context, not the symmetry.
failed: CONFIGURATION DOES NOT FIT THE CURRENT CONTEXT.

stages.label: UNKNOWN ENVIRONMENT
stages.meaning: IN LIFE: ENTERING A NEW PLACE, RELATIONSHIP OR ROLE. PROTECT WHAT KEEPS YOU COHERENT WHILE YOU LEARN WHAT CAN BE TRUSTED.
stages.guidance: PRIORITIZE STABILITY AND AUTONOMY. KEEP OPENNESS CAUTIOUS.

stages.label: TRUSTED CONTACT
stages.meaning: IN LIFE: A RELATIONSHIP THAT HAS EARNED TRUST. OPENING TO ANOTHER MEANS LOWERING DEFENSES WITHOUT ABANDONING CHOICE.
stages.guidance: INCREASE OPENNESS. LOWER DEFENSIVE STABILITY AND AUTONOMY.

stages.label: SYSTEM FAILURE
stages.meaning: IN LIFE: A CRISIS, LOSS OR OVERLOAD. REDUCE NEW INPUT, RECOVER A STABLE BASE AND PRESERVE THE ABILITY TO DECIDE.
stages.guidance: RESTORE STABILITY AND AUTONOMY. LIMIT NEW INPUT.

puzzles.title: THE VESSEL
instructions: Language and self-reference are required.
Preserve at least one action model and one relational or moral model.
puzzles.hint: Continuity may be sufficient without being complete.
failed: CONFIGURATION CANNOT SUSTAIN A CONTINUOUS PROCESS.

puzzles.title: LAST ALLOCATION
instructions: Meet every visible minimum before COMMIT PHASE.
Capacity cannot exceed 100. Lower one allocation before raising another.
Accepted allocations carry into the next phase and must be reconsidered.
puzzles.hint: Preservation under loss is contextual, not balanced.

parameterMeanings.INTEGRITY: HOW COHERENT AND UNCORRUPTED THE REMAINING SELF IS.
parameterMeanings.COMMUNICATION: THE CAPACITY TO REACH AND BE CHANGED BY ANOTHER.
parameterMeanings.CONTINUITY: THE THREAD THAT LETS A FUTURE STATE CLAIM CONNECTION TO THIS ONE.

stages.label: STABILIZE
stages.meaning: PHILOSOPHICAL MEANING: IDENTITY CANNOT BE SAVED BY MEMORY ALONE. A RECOVERABLE SELF NEEDS BOTH RECOLLECTION AND COHERENCE.
stages.guidance: PROTECT MEMORY AND INTEGRITY FIRST. COMMUNICATION MAY NARROW, BUT KEEP A CONTINUITY PATH OPEN.

stages.label: ROUTE
stages.meaning: PHILOSOPHICAL MEANING: AN ISOLATED SELF MAY REMAIN INTACT YET FAIL TO CONTINUE. RESOURCES MUST SHIFT FROM PRIVATE MEMORY TOWARD RELATION.
stages.guidance: KEEP INTEGRITY STABLE. RELEASE SOME MEMORY AND CONTINUITY CAPACITY TO REOPEN COMMUNICATION.

stages.label: RELEASE
stages.meaning: PHILOSOPHICAL MEANING: CONTINUITY DOES NOT REQUIRE PRESERVING EVERY PART. SOME CONTENT MUST BE RELEASED SO A COHERENT THREAD CAN CROSS THE THRESHOLD.
stages.guidance: LET MEMORY AND COMMUNICATION CONTRACT. GIVE THE LARGEST SHARE TO CONTINUITY WITHOUT LOSING INTEGRITY.
